name: nim-default
title: Napster Interactive Museum - landing page
reconstructed: index.html - written for the museum; a plain opening, a feature table, then a short history adapted from Wikipedia
notes: Era A conventions from exhibits/DESIGN.md: black page, #CCCC99 content card, #666666 rail, Arial only, no em dashes. External links are dead in a sealed sandbox unless the config marks them `forward:`, so the Wikipedia attribution is printed as text rather than a link that cannot be followed.

sources.title: Napster
sources.how: adapted, not quoted; attribution shown on the page

slots.<!--nim:media-rail-->: FILES in the left rail: links wearing period filenames. Expanded at serve time from the operator's config.
slots.<!--nim:communities-->: SOCIALS in the left rail. Ships one entry, spacehey, which is forwarded so it opens from inside the sealed client.

links.http://2000.napster.com/: the one historic era, forwarded from the archive
links.http://docs.napster.com/: the library's documentation, generated from its docstrings at request time
links.http://docs.napster.com/help.html: the Help tab: where to put the client, and how to run each mode
